name: straus_completeness_coordinate

phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor ⊣ closes the system as the structured topological framework that contains all coordinate fibres of the 4/n decomposition space, bounding the lossless representation of every unit fraction triple within the primitive ⊣.

VINIT.chosen_element: The empty coordinate space before any 4/n decomposition is encoded
VINIT.justification: The void state 00 represents the uninitialized coordinate system prior to any unit fraction representation being inscribed, before the scale-collapse boundary carries bulk content.

TANCH.chosen_element: The ⊣-defined topological framework that contains all coordinate fibres
TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor ⊣ establishes the closed boundary that holds the entire system of unit fraction decompositions, providing the structured topological framework within which all representations are losslessly encoded.

AFWD.chosen_element: The forward morphism that maps a decomposition to its (r, u) coordinate pair
AFWD.justification: AFWD represents the directed transformation from a triple of unit fractions (x, y, z) satisfying 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z toward the coordinate pair (r, u) where r = 4·min(x,y,z) − n and u = r·mid(x,y,z) − n(n+r)/4, advancing the representation into coordinate space.

AREV.chosen_element: The reverse descent that recovers a unit fraction triple from its (r, u) coordinates
AREV.justification: AREV performs the contravariant descent from the coordinate pair (r, u) back to a valid triple of unit fractions, reversing the forward morphism and closing the representation loop through self-complementary dual parameterization.

CLINK.chosen_element: The sequential composition of coordinate encoding and decoding steps
CLINK.justification: CLINK chains the morphisms of the coordinate map: the scale-collapse that encodes unit fraction decompositions into the boundary, the catalytic transformation that stabilizes representation counts, and the geometric constraints that determine structure, composing them into a single coherent transformation.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: The self-referential identity of the coordinate system recognizing its own lossless encoding
IMSCRIB.justification: IMSCRIB captures the self-recognition that the coordinate map encodes all representations losslessly — the system is itself, and the scale-collapse boundary carries the full bulk content of every 4/n decomposition without loss.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: The coordinate map splitting into the T-arm of constructive truth and the F-arm of constructive falsity
FSPLIT.justification: FSPLIT opens the coordinate space into two arms: the T-arm carrying affirmative representations where 4/n decomposes into three unit fractions, and the F-arm carrying negative states where no such decomposition exists or constraints are violated, reflecting the asymmetric counts from varying denominators.

FFUSE.chosen_element: The rejoining of T-arm and F-arm into a single resolved verdict over SIXTEEN_3
FFUSE.justification: FFUSE reunites the constructive truth and falsity arms via Belnap join into one B4 verdict — when both arms carry valid decompositions they fuse to B (paradice), when only one carries they resolve to T or F, and the fibre size informs the number of representations.

EVALT.chosen_element: The affirmative arm confirming a valid 4/n unit fraction decomposition exists
EVALT.justification: EVALT touches constructive truth T, affirming that for a given n, the coordinate pair (r, u) corresponds to a genuine triple of positive unit fractions summing to 4/n, establishing the representation constructively.

EVALF.chosen_element: The negative arm refuting the existence of a valid decomposition for a given n
EVALF.justification: EVALF touches constructive falsity F, refuting that a particular coordinate pair (r, u) yields a valid triple of positive unit fractions, or that the structural constraints of chirality and symmetry breaking are satisfied.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: The paradice state where both a decomposition and its refutation are simultaneously held
ENGAGR.justification: ENGAGR enters the B-state where a coordinate pair (r, u) both corresponds to a valid unit fraction triple and fails to do so — a dialetheia reflecting overlapping regions, heuristic generic findings, or header class vs entry-size disagreements in the representation structure.

IFIX.chosen_element: The permanent record of a specific 4/n decomposition in (r, u) coordinates
IFIX.justification: IFIX fixes a particular unit fraction representation as an append-only ROM record — once a decomposition 4/n = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z is inscribed into coordinates (r, u), it cannot be undone, creating a permanent measurement record of the representation.

phase_2.split_input: The coordinate map's domain: the space of all candidate 4/n decompositions awaiting evaluation
split_outputs: T-arm: constructive truth of valid unit fraction triples
F-arm: constructive falsity of invalid or non-existent decompositions
phase_2.fuse_result: A single B4 verdict over SIXTEEN_3: T when only valid decompositions exist, F when only refutations hold, B when both are simultaneously present (paradice), N when nothing is established
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.true_description: 01 — Affirmative state where a coordinate pair (r, u) constructively proves a valid triple of positive unit fractions exists for 4/n, with the forward morphism confirming the representation.
phase_3.false_description: 10 — Negative state where a coordinate pair (r, u) constructively refutes the existence of a valid unit fraction decomposition, or where structural constraints of chirality and symmetry breaking are violated.
phase_3.both_description: 11 — Paradice state where both a valid decomposition and its refutation are simultaneously held for the same coordinate pair (r, u), a contradiction kept live without resolution, reflecting overlapping regions or heuristic generic findings.
